subject: general
question: The first Digital Food Museum in India was launched in ________ in the year 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first digital **food museum **in India electronically opened in **Thanjavur**, **Tamil Nadu,** in November 2021, thanks to **Union Minister Piyush Goyal**.
 
• 
 
Thanjavur was chosen as the location for India's first digital food museum since it is the birthplace of the FCI.

 
 
• 
 
**Established by -**

 
 
• 
 
**​Food Corporation of India (FCI)** and **Visvesvaraya Industrial and Technological Museum** (VITM), both located in Bengaluru, collaborated to construct the museum with an estimated investment of Rs. 1.1 crore.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Area - 1,860 **square foot museum 

 
 
• ** Museum display includes -**
 
 
• The Indian **food progression **from **nomadic hunters **and gatherers to sedentary **agricultural producers**.
 
• The **history of humanity** from **foragers **to **producers **along with the tale of the first harvest, the development of villages, and the planning of demand days.
 
• **Indian grains **and discuss the many food cultures around the world. 
 
• The **journey of the food grain** from the farm to the consumer's plate and the part played by FCI in it.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the Food Corporation Act of 1964, the Food Corporation of India was established to carry out the goals of the Food Policy as the country was facing a major shortage of food grain, especially wheat. 
 
• The **objectives **of FCI are - 
 
 
• Operationally sound **price support** to protect the interests of **farmers**
 
• distribution of food grains for **public distribution systems** around the nation.
 
• Maintaining operational and **buffer inventories **of food grains is necessary to guarantee the ongoing availability of **staple foods.**
 
• **Food grain market prices** should be regulated to keep them reasonable for the general public to purchase.
